text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim against driverless cars","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite position right away and lets the reader know exactly what the essay will argue."},{"evidence":"repeated reasons about accidents, liability, and lost driving skills","quality":"argument development","description":"It builds its case with multiple related reasons instead of mostly listing information."},{"evidence":"\"What if you do get in an accident... whose fault will it be?\"","quality":"use of supporting reasoning","description":"It explains why a concern matters by connecting the article’s ideas to likely consequences."},{"evidence":"\"Let's be honest... they might not even know the car needs them to be alert\"","quality":"reader awareness","description":"It anticipates how ordinary buyers might misunderstand the product and uses that to strengthen the argument."},{"evidence":"four body paragraphs with a closing statement","quality":"organization","description":"It has a more complete essay structure with clearer introduction, body, and conclusion."}]}
